text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

Red Desire ran solidly
all the way through the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.

âI am certain.
Red Desire has even more room to grow.
She has what it takes to fiercely pursue Buena Vista.
However—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista-san!
That was a magnificent late surge today!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Please, tell us your ambitions for next year's Classic year!
The media's attention was... as expected, focused entirely on Buena Vista.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
I shall be on my way now...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Buena-san, that was simply marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what is it!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Racing alongside you for the first time before such a massive crowd... I was once again overwhelmed by your strength.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"And it was etched deeply into my soul.
—That you truly are my greatest trial."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Desire-chan...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista is a trial...?
J-Just what kind of girl is she...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —My name is the Saint, Red Desire.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I am one whose destiny is shared with Buena-san,
the beloved child of this world.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
If you are to write the destiny of the world from here on...
please do not forget my name.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah...
What a peculiar kid...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Reporters,
you just asked about my enthusiasm
for the Classic stage, correct?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Next year, I'll put my heart and soul into every single race so that I can live up to everyone's expectations!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Together with Desire-chan! Right?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Yes!
You're completely right, Buena-san...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Even at the academy, Desire-chan and I have competed against each other in mock races many times.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Desire-chan is such a hard worker, chasing her big dreams with all she's got...
She's been a huge inspiration to me, too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why I'm so looking forward to competing on the Classic stage."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Let's both get way, way stronger than we are today
and run the best race ever. I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Buena...!
That pure benevolence... Truly a genuine radiance!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Ordeal though it may be, I am utterly overjoyed
to be able to fight you with everything I have."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Let us make a pledge right here and now!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Next year, I, the Holy Maiden Red Desire,
shall show you a race that transcends the very logic of this world—!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I-I don't really get what's going on, but it's intense...! Take more pictures of those two!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
I thought Buena was totally uncontested, but next year...
we might be in for some unexpected upsets.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu♪

It seems she managed to leave quite an impression.
...In her own, rather "special" way.
And so, Red Desire's true ability garnered more attention than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... It is finally time.
To think that so many people are beginning
to seek the guidance of the Saint...!
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to next year!
I'm looking forward to next year!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes. Thanks to your support as well... the preparations are all in order.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Let us go. Toward the greatest trial to come—
the battles of the Classic Year!

I clench my fist tightly.
Once she reaches the Classic Class, the "Tale of the Saint" will truly begin—!
